title: Meta-analysis of fecal metagenomes reveals global microbial signatures that are specific for colorectal cancer
what_it_does: LOSO CRC classifiers across 8 cohorts; cut-offs set at FPR=0.1 on training controls and realised FPR assessed on other-disease cohorts to test disease specificity
how_our_work_differs: Wirbel use a fixed FPR cut-off only to probe disease specificity on non-CRC cohorts, whereas we quantify the dispersion of realised specificity in held-out CRC cohorts' own controls and re-estimate the threshold label-free.
verified_via: Crossref API 2026-11-23; Europe PMC full text PMC7984229

title: Metagenomic analysis of colorectal cancer datasets identifies cross-cohort microbial diagnostic signatures and a link with choline degradation
what_it_does: Cross-cohort/LODO random-forest CRC classifiers reported by AUROC
how_our_work_differs: Reports discrimination (AUROC) only; no fixed-operating-point transfer analysis or threshold re-estimation.

title: Machine Learning Meta-analysis of Large Metagenomic Datasets: Tools and Biological Insights
what_it_does: MetAML cross-study and LODO classification for several diseases, AUROC-based
how_our_work_differs: AUROC-only cross-dataset evaluation; no operating-point analysis.

title: Accessible, curated metagenomic data through ExperimentHub
what_it_does: curatedMetagenomicData resource
how_our_work_differs: Data source we use; no methodological overlap.

title: Potential of fecal microbiota for early-stage detection of colorectal cancer
what_it_does: LASSO metagenomic CRC classifier with external validation and comparison/combination with FOBT
how_our_work_differs: Single-study classifier with cut-offs chosen in-sample; no cross-cohort threshold transfer study.

title: Meta-analysis of gut microbiome studies identifies disease-specific and shared responses
what_it_does: Per-study classifiers (AUROC) and shared vs disease-specific signatures across 28 16S studies
how_our_work_differs: Within-study AUROC; no deployed-threshold evaluation.

title: A predictive index for health status using species-level gut microbiome profiling
what_it_does: GMHI score with a fixed cut-off (0) to classify healthy vs non-healthy across many cohorts
how_our_work_differs: GMHI applies one fixed universal cut-off and reports balanced accuracy; it does not study cohort-wise drift of that cut-off or adapt it label-free.

title: Gut Microbiome Wellness Index 2 enhances health status prediction from gut microbiome taxonomic profiles
what_it_does: GMWI2 classifier with fixed cut-off, cross-study validation
how_our_work_differs: Fixed universal cut-off without per-site operating-point diagnosis or re-estimation.

title: Microbiome meta-analysis and cross-disease comparison enabled by the SIAMCAT machine learning toolbox
what_it_does: SIAMCAT toolbox and large cross-disease LOSO meta-analysis; AUROC centred
how_our_work_differs: Tooling/AUROC evaluation; no label-free threshold adaptation.

title: Population structure discovery in meta-analyzed microbial communities and inflammatory bowel disease using MMUPHin
what_it_does: Feature-level batch correction and meta-analysis across studies (requires study labels; adjusts features)
how_our_work_differs: Corrects input features using known batch and covariates; we act on the output score at a fixed operating point using only unlabeled target scores.

title: Batch effects removal for microbiome data via conditional quantile regression
what_it_does: ConQuR: quantile-regression batch removal of taxon counts toward a reference batch
how_our_work_differs: Feature-space harmonisation, needs covariates incl. disease status in model; does not target realised FPR at a decision threshold.

title: Correcting for batch effects in case-control microbiome studies
what_it_does: Percentile normalisation of each feature against the study's own labelled controls
how_our_work_differs: Uses labelled local controls to normalise features (cf. our conformal-from-controls baseline); our main method needs no labels and works on scores.

title: PLSDA-batch: a multivariate framework to correct for batch effects in microbiome data
what_it_does: Multivariate batch correction preserving treatment effect
how_our_work_differs: Feature-level, labelled-batch method; no operating-point analysis.

title: A cautionary tale of batch corrections on confounded microbiome community profiles
what_it_does: Shows batch corrections can distort confounded case-control profiles
how_our_work_differs: Critique of feature correction; motivates score-level label-free adaptation but does not propose it.

title: Benchmark of Data Processing Methods and Machine Learning Models for Gut Microbiome-Based Diagnosis of Inflammatory Bowel Disease
what_it_does: Leave-one-dataset-out benchmark of preprocessing/batch correction for IBD classifiers
how_our_work_differs: AUROC/accuracy benchmark; no fixed-threshold transfer or label-free threshold re-estimation.

title: Performance of Gut Microbiome as an Independent Diagnostic Tool for 20 Diseases: Cross-Cohort Validation of Machine-Learning Classifiers
what_it_does: Cross-cohort AUROC for 20 diseases; combined-cohort classifiers; sample-size estimates
how_our_work_differs: AUROC-only transfer; we show threshold/FPR non-transfer even when AUROC holds.

title: Best practices for developing microbiome-based disease diagnostic classifiers through machine learning
what_it_does: Benchmarks 156 preprocessing/batch/algorithm combos across 83 cohorts by internal/external AUC
how_our_work_differs: Recommendations ranked by AUC only; operating-point transfer not assessed.

title: Identification of microbial markers across populations in early detection of colorectal cancer
what_it_does: Cross-population CRC/adenoma markers and classifiers, AUROC evaluated
how_our_work_differs: No fixed-specificity transfer analysis.

title: Pooled analysis of 3,741 stool metagenomes from 18 cohorts for cross-stage and strain-level reproducible microbial biomarkers of colorectal cancer
what_it_does: 18-cohort CRC metagenomic LOSO prediction (mean AUC 0.85), stage/strain biomarkers
how_our_work_differs: State-of-the-art AUROC benchmark; does not report realised FPR at a fixed deployed threshold or adapt thresholds.

title: Cross-cohort analysis identifies shared gut microbial signatures and validates microbial risk scores for colorectal cancer
what_it_does: Cross-cohort validation of microbial risk scores for CRC
how_our_work_differs: Risk scores validated by discrimination; threshold transport not studied.

title: CRC-TrustBench: benchmarking cross-study and cross-country generalization in gut metagenomic colorectal cancer prediction
what_it_does: LOSO/LOCO benchmark of 15 CRC studies with Platt calibration, conformal-style sets and abstention evaluated without outer-test labels
how_our_work_differs: Closest microbiome benchmark: covers calibration/coverage under LOSO but not realised FPR dispersion at a fixed operating point nor label-free mixture-based threshold re-estimation.

title: Cross-cohort oral microbiome meta-analysis identifies shared OPMD-OSCC dysbiosis while machine learning exposes limits of OSCC classifier transportability
what_it_does: Nested leave-one-cohort-out OSCC classifiers; AUROC transport and cohort-identity leakage
how_our_work_differs: Transportability judged by AUROC; no operating-point/threshold transfer analysis (abstract).

title: Grassmannian Geodesic Distance Predicts Cross-Cohort Classifier Degradation Under Analytical Heterogeneity, After Controlling for Source Classifier Quality
what_it_does: Predicts cross-cohort AUC gap from unlabeled PCA-subspace distance (CRC microbiome, 9 studies)
how_our_work_differs: Label-free predictor of AUC loss; we target threshold/FPR loss and correct it.

title: Quantifying subject-level data leakage in gut-microbiome classifiers for inflammatory bowel disease: a pre-registered multi-cohort audit and calibration study
what_it_does: Pre-registered audit of subject-level leakage and calibration across evaluation schemes
how_our_work_differs: About leakage inflation of discrimination; not threshold transport.

title: A decade-scale audit of microbiome AI-readiness
what_it_does: PRISMA audit of metadata/sequence sharing for 2,896 microbiome studies
how_our_work_differs: Data availability audit; no classifier evaluation.

title: Adjusting the Outputs of a Classifier to New a Priori Probabilities: A Simple Procedure
what_it_does: EM re-estimation of target class priors from unlabeled data and posterior adjustment
how_our_work_differs: Assumes class-conditional score distributions are unchanged (pure prior shift); our model additionally fits an affine score shift a+b*s, which is what moves FPR at a fixed cut-off.

title: Detecting and Correcting for Label Shift with Black Box Predictors
what_it_does: BBSE: confusion-matrix based label-shift estimation from black-box predictions
how_our_work_differs: Pure label-shift; no conditional (score-scale) shift and no operating-point focus.

title: Maximum Likelihood with Bias-Corrected Calibration is Hard-To-Beat at Label Shift Adaptation
what_it_does: EM/MLE label-shift adaptation with bias-corrected calibration
how_our_work_differs: Prior-only adaptation; we estimate a location-scale score shift jointly with prior.

title: Regularized Learning for Domain Adaptation under Label Shifts
what_it_does: RLLS regularised importance-weight estimation under label shift
how_our_work_differs: Label-shift weights for retraining; not threshold/FPR control under score shift.

title: A Unified View of Label Shift Estimation
what_it_does: Unifies BBSE and MLLS label-shift estimators
how_our_work_differs: Theory for prior estimation under fixed class conditionals; we relax that via affine score shift.

title: Domain Adaptation under Target and Conditional Shift
what_it_does: Generalized target shift: joint change of class prior and constrained (location-scale) transformation of class-conditionals, estimated from unlabeled target by kernel mean matching
how_our_work_differs: Mathematically closest ML ancestor of our site-shift model, but in feature space with kernel matching; we apply a 1-D score-level affine shift by ML on unlabeled scores to set an operating point.

title: Domain Adaptation with Conditional Distribution Matching and Generalized Label Shift
what_it_does: Generalized label shift with representation alignment and importance weights
how_our_work_differs: Representation learning approach; no fixed-FPR threshold transfer.

title: Mapping conditional distributions for domain adaptation under generalized target shift
what_it_does: OT-based mapping of class-conditionals plus prior estimation under GeTarS
how_our_work_differs: General feature-space mapping; we use a parametric 1-D score map tailored to operating-point recovery.

title: Distribution-free uncertainty quantification for classification under label shift
what_it_does: Weighted conformal prediction sets valid under label shift
how_our_work_differs: Coverage for prediction sets under pure label shift; we target FPR at a binary cut-off under score shift.

title: Conformal Prediction Under Covariate Shift
what_it_does: Weighted conformal prediction with likelihood-ratio weights
how_our_work_differs: Covariate-shift conformal; our conformal baseline uses a few labelled local controls instead.

title: Adaptive Conformal Inference Under Distribution Shift
what_it_does: Online adaptive conformal under arbitrary shift with label feedback
how_our_work_differs: Requires sequential labels; ours label-free.

title: Learn then test: Calibrating predictive algorithms to achieve risk control
what_it_does: Selects thresholds with finite-sample risk (e.g. FPR) control using labelled calibration data
how_our_work_differs: Needs labelled calibration data from target; our core method uses unlabeled target scores.

title: Neyman-Pearson classification algorithms and NP receiver operating characteristics
what_it_does: NP umbrella algorithm: threshold with high-probability type-I error control from labelled class-0 data
how_our_work_differs: Guarantees FPR on the source population only; does not address FPR transfer to a shifted site.

title: A Generalized Neyman-Pearson Criterion for Optimal Domain Adaptation
what_it_does: Generalized NP criterion for domain adaptation
how_our_work_differs: Theoretical criterion; no score-mixture threshold estimator or biomedical evaluation.

title: Neyman-Pearson Classification under Both Null and Alternative Distributions Shift
what_it_does: Adaptive transfer for NP classification when both null and alternative shift, with guarantees
how_our_work_differs: Uses (some) labelled target data for transfer; ours is unlabeled-target score-level re-thresholding.

title: Shift-adjusted Neyman-Pearson classifiers via single index modeling (SACSIM)
what_it_does: Adapts NP decision rules to a target population using small unlabeled target sample + auxiliary info, semi-parametric, cancer detection example
how_our_work_differs: Very close aim (FPR-constrained rule adapted with unlabeled target data); differs in model (single-index covariate model + auxiliary info vs our affine score-shift mixture on black-box scores) and in having no microbiome multi-cohort evaluation.

title: Automatic correction of performance drift under acquisition shift in medical image classification
what_it_does: Unsupervised Prediction Alignment: label-free matching of target score distribution to source to preserve sensitivity/specificity; shows drift even when AUROC holds
how_our_work_differs: Same problem and claim (operating-point drift with AUROC intact, label-free fix); UPA aligns whole score CDFs assuming unchanged prevalence, whereas our mixture separates prevalence from affine score shift; we are in microbiome across 11+ cohorts.

title: Deployment of Image Analysis Algorithms Under Prevalence Shifts
what_it_does: Shows prevalence shift harms calibration/threshold; estimates deployment prevalence label-free and re-adjusts
how_our_work_differs: Prevalence-only adjustment; does not model class-conditional score shift that changes FPR.

title: Navigating prevalence shifts in image analysis algorithm deployment
what_it_does: 30 tasks: prevalence shift effects on calibration, decision threshold, metrics; label-free prevalence-aware workflow
how_our_work_differs: Same as above: prior-shift only; our failure mode is conditional/score shift at fixed operating point in microbiome.

title: Leveraging shared feature representation in cross-domain alignment of decision thresholds for electronic health records data
what_it_does: Generative shared-representation learning with unlabeled target EHR data to align output probabilities/thresholds
how_our_work_differs: Requires retraining a representation with target features; ours is post-hoc on black-box scores with an explicit mixture likelihood.

title: Aligning Evaluation with Clinical Priorities: Calibration, Label Shift, and Error Costs
what_it_does: Cost-weighted proper-scoring evaluation averaged over plausible prevalences for thresholded classifiers
how_our_work_differs: Evaluation-metric proposal for prevalence uncertainty; not site-specific threshold re-estimation or realised-FPR reporting.

title: Prior-Shift-Invariant Threshold Transport in Budget-Constrained Supervisory Screening: Workload Identity, Prior-Drift Decomposition, and Distribution-Free Risk Control
what_it_does: Shows that under pure prior shift a fixed cut-off keeps TPR/FPR while AUROC is uninformative of workload; cut-off transport dominates rate transport
how_our_work_differs: Under pure prior shift FPR is invariant by construction; our finding is that FPR itself is NOT invariant across microbiome cohorts (conditional shift), requiring re-estimation.

title: Threshold Transportability and Post-Training Threshold Adaptation in Clinical Tabular AI: A Multi-Dimensional Evaluation for Gestational Diabetes Prediction
what_it_does: Evaluates threshold transportability and post-training threshold adaptation for GDM models (abstract not retrievable)
how_our_work_differs: Different domain (tabular GDM); content beyond title not verified; no evidence of unlabeled mixture-based re-estimation.

title: Reproducibility and external threshold-transfer audit of transfer-learning CNNs for pediatric chest X-ray pneumonia detection
what_it_does: External threshold-transfer audit of CNN pneumonia detectors (abstract not retrievable)
how_our_work_differs: Imaging audit of threshold transfer (cf. our contribution a) in another field; no label-free re-estimation evident.

title: Hierarchical biomarker thresholding: a model-agnostic framework for stability
what_it_does: Risk decomposition separating operating-point shift (prevalence and shape) and stability for patient-level thresholds across sites
how_our_work_differs: Diagnostic decomposition/stability framework; does not estimate the target threshold from unlabeled target scores.

title: Generative modelling for unsupervised score calibration
what_it_does: Fits a 2-component GMM to unlabeled verification scores to calibrate decisions without labels
how_our_work_differs: Direct analogue of (b): unlabeled 2-class score mixture for decision calibration; ours transports empirical class shapes from labelled source via affine map rather than free Gaussian components, targets fixed FPR, in microbiome.

title: On the Distribution of Speaker Verification Scores: Generative Models for Unsupervised Calibration
what_it_does: Non-Gaussian generative score models for unsupervised/semi-supervised linear calibration
how_our_work_differs: Same family as (b); differs in shape model (parametric NVM vs source-transported shapes) and target (LLR calibration vs fixed-FPR threshold).

title: Normal Variance-Mean Mixtures for Unsupervised Score Calibration
what_it_does: Asymmetric NVM mixtures of target/non-target scores for unsupervised calibration
how_our_work_differs: Analogue of (b) with parametric class shapes; no cross-cohort biomedical setting.

title: A Generative Approach to Condition-Aware Score Calibration for Speaker Verification
what_it_does: EM over latent conditions for condition-aware generative calibration
how_our_work_differs: Condition-aware calibration with labels for training; related to site-specific shift modelling but not unlabeled re-thresholding per site.

title: Score Normalization for Text-Independent Speaker Verification Systems
what_it_does: Z-norm/T-norm: affine normalisation of scores using impostor (negative) score statistics to stabilise a global threshold
how_our_work_differs: Affine score normalisation using known-negative cohorts (cf. our conformal-from-controls baseline); ours estimates the affine map from an unlabeled mixture.

title: Feature and score normalization for speaker verification of cellular data
what_it_does: Combines feature and score normalisation for cross-channel verification
how_our_work_differs: Uses labelled impostor sets; not unlabeled mixture estimation.

title: A plea for intra-laboratory reference limits. Part 2. A bimodal retrospective concept for determining reference limits from intra-laboratory databases demonstrated by catalytic activity concentrations of enzymes
what_it_does: Separates healthy component (power-normal) from pathological in unlabeled routine data to estimate reference limits (TML precursor)
how_our_work_differs: Cross-field analogue of (b): healthy-quantile threshold from unlabeled mixed data; ours uses classifier scores, transports class shapes from a labelled source and models the site shift as affine.

title: Reference Interval Estimation from Mixed Distributions using Truncation Points and the Kolmogorov-Smirnov Distance (kosmic)
what_it_does: kosmic: fits Box-Cox normal healthy component to truncated unlabeled mixed data
how_our_work_differs: Same 'healthy quantile from unlabeled mixture' idea; parametric healthy shape vs our source-transported shape + affine shift.

title: refineR: A Novel Algorithm for Reference Interval Estimation from Real-World Data
what_it_does: Inverse modelling of non-pathological (modified Box-Cox) distribution within unlabeled routine data
how_our_work_differs: Analogue of (b); no use of a labelled source distribution or classifier scores.

title: RIbench: A Proposed Benchmark for the Standardized Evaluation of Indirect Methods for Reference Interval Estimation
what_it_does: Simulation benchmark of indirect RI methods vs pathological fraction
how_our_work_differs: Benchmark design analogue for our evaluation of label-free threshold estimators.

title: Mixture density networks for the indirect estimation of reference intervals
what_it_does: Mixture density networks estimate covariate-dependent healthy component from unlabeled data
how_our_work_differs: Analogue of (b) with covariates; not classifier-score operating points.

title: How Gaussian mixture modelling can help to verify reference intervals from laboratory data with a high proportion of pathological values
what_it_does: GMM on unlabeled lab data to verify reference limits with high pathological fraction
how_our_work_differs: Analogue: verifies a transported limit at a new lab label-free (like our threshold check); differs in data type and shift model.

title: Indirect methods for the verification of reference intervals in laboratory medicine
venue: Critical Reviews in Clinical Laboratory Sciences
what_it_does: Review of indirect methods to verify transferred reference intervals at a local lab
how_our_work_differs: Establishes 'verify transferred cut-off locally from unlabeled data' as standard in lab medicine; we import this into microbiome classifier deployment.

title: Generalized Bayes Quantification Learning under Dataset Shift
venue: Journal of the American Statistical Association
what_it_does: Prevalence estimation when sensitivities/specificities do not transport, using small labelled target subset
how_our_work_differs: Shows non-transport of Se/Sp but goal is prevalence, with labelled target data; ours is label-free threshold setting.

title: Learning to Quantify: Estimating Class Prevalence via Supervised Learning
what_it_does: Tutorial on quantification (CC, ACC, EM-based) methods
how_our_work_differs: Prevalence estimation literature; does not address FPR at a fixed threshold under conditional shift.

title: Does quantification without adjustments work?
what_it_does: Analyses classify-and-count vs adjusted quantification under prior shift
how_our_work_differs: Prior-shift theory only.

title: Class-prior estimation for learning from positive and unlabeled data
what_it_does: Class-prior estimation from positive + unlabeled data
how_our_work_differs: Mixture proportion estimation without shift of the component; we estimate component shift too.

title: Mixture Proportion Estimation via Kernel Embedding of Distributions
what_it_does: Kernel MPE of a component in an unlabeled mixture
how_our_work_differs: MPE assumes known component distribution; ours lets component undergo affine shift.

title: Mixture Proportion Estimation and PU Learning: A Modern Approach
what_it_does: Best Bin Estimation on classifier scores for MPE
how_our_work_differs: Score-based MPE without component shift; not for thresholds.

title: Leveraging Unlabeled Data to Predict Out-of-Distribution Performance
what_it_does: ATC: learns confidence threshold on source to predict target accuracy label-free
how_our_work_differs: Predicts accuracy label-free; does not control/recover FPR at a clinical operating point.

title: Detection of calibration drift in clinical prediction models to inform model updating
what_it_does: Monitoring calibration drift to trigger updating (labelled outcomes)
how_our_work_differs: Requires outcomes; ours label-free and threshold-focused.

title: Updating methods improved the performance of a clinical prediction model in new patients
what_it_does: Intercept/slope recalibration and revision with local labelled data
how_our_work_differs: Logistic recalibration (a + b*logit) needs local outcomes; our affine score shift is fitted from unlabeled scores.

title: A review of statistical updating methods for clinical prediction models
what_it_does: Review of recalibration/updating methods
how_our_work_differs: All reviewed updating methods use labelled local data.

title: A calibration hierarchy for risk models was defined: from utopia to empirical data
what_it_does: Defines mean/weak/moderate/strong calibration
how_our_work_differs: Conceptual calibration framework; not operating-point transport.

title: Calibration: the Achilles heel of predictive analytics
what_it_does: Argues calibration (not just AUROC) must be reported
how_our_work_differs: Supports our argument (c) generically; no microbiome or label-free method.

title: External validation of clinical prediction models using big datasets from e-health records or IPD meta-analysis: opportunities and challenges
what_it_does: Advocates examining between-cluster heterogeneity of calibration/discrimination in external validation
how_our_work_differs: Analogous call to report per-site heterogeneity; we quantify overdispersion of realised specificity specifically.

title: From development to deployment: dataset shift, causality, and shift-stable models in health AI
what_it_does: Overview of dataset shift and stable models
how_our_work_differs: General framing only.

title: When Average Calibration Fails: Site-Conditional Federated Conformal Risk Control
what_it_does: Shows pooled conformal threshold violates target FNR at 40% of sites; site-conditional shrinkage
how_our_work_differs: Analogue of (a) (pooled threshold fails per site) in segmentation; uses labelled site calibration data.

title: Unlabeled Spectral Shift Informs Target-Label Acquisition Strategy Selection for Cross-Site MALDI-TOF Antimicrobial Resistance Prediction
what_it_does: Cross-site MALDI-TOF AMR: unsupervised adaptation fails; small local label budget recommended
how_our_work_differs: Finds label-free adaptation did not restore PR-AUC; we target threshold only, where label-free re-estimation may suffice.

title: The dashboard says 'perfect:' a systematic audit of label-free model monitoring and test-time adaptation under temporal distribution shift
what_it_does: Audits label-free monitoring/TTA under temporal shift
how_our_work_differs: Generic audit; not threshold re-estimation for diagnostics.

title: Robust Label Shift Correction via Denoising Expectation-Maximization
what_it_does: Denoised EM for label-shift correction
how_our_work_differs: Prior-shift only.

title: Quantitative fecal immunochemical tests for colorectal cancer screening
what_it_does: Review of quantitative FIT performance across cut-offs and settings
how_our_work_differs: Documents cut-off dependence of FIT across populations (domain analogue for (a)); no classifier/label-free method.

title: A Reality Gap Taxonomy for Physics-Informed Anomaly Detection in Industrial Control Systems: Cross-Regime Evaluation, Operating-Point and Temporal Distribution Shifts
what_it_does: Cross-regime evaluation of anomaly detectors including operating-point transfer
how_our_work_differs: Operating-point non-transfer in industrial anomaly detection (analogue of (a)); different field and no mixture re-estimation evident.

title: System and method for classification of image data items based on indirect user input (US 8,934,722 B2)
what_it_does: Classifier thresholds adjusted to conform to a received set of unlabeled images from the current stream
how_our_work_differs: Patent claims generic threshold adjustment to unlabeled data; not an affine-shift mixture ML estimator nor fixed-FPR microbiome deployment. Prior-art relevance for any patent claim on (b).

title: Typed Decision Models under Prevalence Shift and Label Budgets: Decision Training, Calibration, and Implicit Priors
what_it_does: Tests calibration/threshold robustness to prevalence shift and label-budget curves
how_our_work_differs: Different model class and pure prevalence shift.
